title: Directory listing sorts wrongly
prompt:
test_given.py fails. Fix sort_names in names.py.

Requirements:
- Case-insensitive primary ordering, using Unicode normalisation so that
  composed and decomposed accents compare equal.
- Ties broken by the exact original string, so ordering is deterministic.
- Accented and non-ASCII names must sort next to their base letters, not at the
  end, and must never raise.
- Items that are not strings are rejected with TypeError.
- Input must not be mutated.

Only names.py should change.
